variants.title: A · 帆形天线
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the supplied official Bilibili small television mascot. Create a BiliSail app-icon design variation based closely on THIS small-TV graphic, preserving its recognizability. The user's correction is crucial: the previous concept looked too much like a sailboat. This time the television must be the unmistakable main subject, about 85-90% of the visual identity; the sailing addition is a subtle 10-15% accent only.
Invariants: keep the thick rounded rectangular TV frame, near-original horizontal body proportions, both tilted rectangular eyes, the friendly little W-shaped mouth, short rounded feet, and the familiar antenna character. Do not replace the face with a sail, do not turn the television into a large boat, do not add huge sails above it. Recolor the main TV frame, eyes and mouth to Bilibili pink #FB7299. Keep the screen interior clean opaque white. Small sailing accents use cyan #00AEEC. All forms must be clean, bold and minimal, with gently rounded edges and enough thickness to survive 32px.
Style: polished flat vector-like graphic, precise smooth edges, solid color, no gradients or textures, no 3D, no shadows. One single optically centered icon on a square transparent canvas, occupying roughly 80% of the canvas in each direction. Preserve true alpha outside the emblem. No surrounding square tile, no background, no lettering, no words, no watermark, no extra decoration, no presentation board, no multiple designs in one image.
Variant-specific change:
Keep the original TV face, frame, mouth, feet and left diagonal antenna intact. Integrate one SMALL cyan triangular sail along the right antenna: the right antenna becomes a short mast supporting the tiny sail, occupying only the original antenna zone and slightly beyond it. The sail should look organically designed into that antenna rather than a large object mounted above the TV. Keep the original left-right antenna rhythm, and keep the TV body much larger and heavier than this sail. No wave and no boat hull. This is a small television with a sail-shaped antenna, immediately recognizable as the Bilibili TV.
